senses.gloss: The third letter of the dental class, and eighteenth consonant in the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter D.

n. (दं)
A wife.
nf. (दं दा)
1 Gift, donation.
2 Dividing, cutting, breaking, &c.
f. (दा)
1 Purifying, cleansing.
2 Preserving, cherishing.
3 Repentance.
m. (दः)
1 A donor, a giver.
2 A mountain.
3 A gift, a thing given.
E.
दा to give, or दो to cut, &c. affix ड.

(ण) दाण r. 1st cl. (यच्छति, or with सम् prefixed संयच्छते); also (डु ञ्) डुदाञ् r. 3rd cl. (ददाति)
To give, to present.
With आङ् prefixed
(आदत्ते),
To take, to accept or receive.
With प्र,
To give, to give to.
With वि and आङ्,
To open.
With सम and आङ्,
To select.
(प) दाप् r. 2nd cl. (दाति)
To cut.
